text: Which of the following is an open problem in HoTT as of 2025?
choices: coherence for general HITs (that arbitrary HIT elimination rules are consistent)
whether univalence is consistent (already proved via simplicial set model)
explanation: General HIT coherence: it is not fully proved that all HITs with arbitrary path constructors can be realized in all models. Specific HITs (circle, pushouts, truncations) are fine.
